site.tagline: Easy-language drafts of Swiss official texts. Apertus writes, code checks, you decide.
site.footer: A drafting assistant for professionals: every draft needs a human review, and a review by readers from the target group before publication.
index.title: Turn an official text into easy language
index.lede: Paste a letter, give a web address, or upload a PDF. Apertus, the Swiss open model, reads it and writes a draft in Leichte Sprache or FALC. Code checks the rules and every deadline, amount and phone number. You review and export.
index.how.write_text: A fact sheet with every value first, then the draft. Every sentence links back to its source.
index.how.check_text: {count} rules from the Swiss guidelines, in milliseconds. No fact may get lost.
index.how.judge_text: A second model checks the meaning. Only the flagged blocks are rewritten.
index.how.review_text: Approve, edit or reject each block. Markdown, HTML, or the JSON audit trail.
